manifest.name: parse_supplier_invoices
manifest.description: Parses supplier invoice .txt files (Czech and English layouts) in folder/invoices into records with supplier, number, VS, dates, PO, items, total.
manifest.notes: No network. Files at inbox/<folder>/invoices/*.txt. Czech layout: 'FAKTURA - DAŇOVÝ DOKLAD č. X', 'Variabilní symbol:', 'CELKEM K ÚHRADĚ: 1 234,50 Kč', fixed-width items with 'ks'. English (OfficeLine): pipe-separated items, '1,234.50' numbers. RESENT duplicate files exist (same invoice number, header 'Upomínka'); flagged as resent.

files.test_impl.py:
import pytest
from impl import run


def test_example():
    r = run({'folder': 'novak_trading'})
    assert len(r['invoices']) >= 12
    t = [i for i in r['invoices'] if i['invoice_number'] == 'TP1114'][0]
    assert t['vs'] == '1114' and t['total'] == 11954.80 and len(t['items']) == 2
    assert t['date'] == '2026-08-22'


def test_english(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    d = tmp_path / 'inbox' / 'x' / 'invoices'
    d.mkdir(parents=True)
    (d / 'a.txt').write_text('INVOICE\n\nACME GmbH, Street 1\nInvoice number: A-1\nInvoice date: 2026-01-02\n\nSKU | Description | Qty | Unit price (CZK) | Amount (CZK)\nS1 | Thing | 2 | 10.00 | 20.00\n\nTotal due: 24.20 CZK\n')
    (d / 'bad.txt').write_text('hello')
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    r = run({'folder': 'x'})
    assert r['invoices'][0]['total'] == 24.2 and r['invoices'][0]['items'][0]['qty'] == 2
    assert len(r['errors']) == 1


def test_bad():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'folder': 'nonexistent_zzz'})
